name: pu_ga_delta
cite: LA-3067 pit: mass 6.15 kg, OD 9.17 cm (C-102). MAJ-28: density DERIVED = 15.23 g/cm3 (solid sphere); the commonly quoted delta-phase Pu-Ga alloy density 15.6 is inconsistent with the mass/OD pair by ~2.4%, recorded not resolved. Composition: 3.35 at% Ga total (~1.0 wt%), Pu-240 = 1.0 wt% of Pu (super-grade, ~150-day Hanford irradiation) per the research doc Trinity technical reference. Ga split Ga-69/Ga-71 = 60.108/39.892 (IUPAC standard) by explicit author choice per 03 section 3.
